day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadkii Labaad iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Adiga, Rabbiyow, ayaan u bixin doonaa allabariga ammaanta.
homily:
Waxaa jira waxyaabo nolosha ka mid ah oo u muuqda kuwo aan la arki karin, laakiin haddana leh miisaan weyn. Bal qiyaas wiil yar oo fadhiya miiskiisa, isagoo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya diyaarad model ah, ama isagoo koodhka kumbuyuutarka u qoraya si uu u abuuro wax cusub. Waa daqiiqado aamusnaan ah oo ay ka buuxdo ujeeddo. Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu waxyaabaha yaryar u rogo waxyaabo waaweyn. Ma aha oo kaliya farsamadiisa, laakiin xitaa riyooyinkiisa 'Con Chim Airlines' ee uu si qosol leh uga sheekayn jiray. Wuxuu ahaa wiil dhisayay aasaas adag, ma aha oo kaliya aqoontiisa, laakiin qalbigiisa.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Qofkii i ag yimaada, oo ereyadayda maqla, oo sameeya, waxaan tusi doonaa waxa uu la mid yahay. Wuxuu la mid yahay nin guri dhisaya, oo si qoto dheer u qoday, oo aasaaskii dhigay dhagax.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qodayay aasaaskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu dadka kale ka dhigo kuwo muhiim ah. Xusuusnow markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa aasaaska dhagaxa ah ee aan gariirin karin.

Alan iyo Thao, laba bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale, June 13, 2026. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad oo naxariis leh: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, ee aad u sheegi jirtay sheekooyinka aad ku qosli jirteen, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Waxaad ahaydeen waalidkii ugu fiicnaa. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka uu Ben dareemay, iyo xanuunka aad hadda dareemaysaan, ma aha natiijada wax aad samayseen ama aad seegteen. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Nolosha mararka qaarkood waxay leedahay duufaanno aan la saadaalin karin, laakiin aasaaska jacaylka aad Ben u qabteen waa mid aan la dumineyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Koobka barakada ee aynu barakayno, miyaanu ahayn wadaagga dhiigga Masiixu?' Bawlos wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa inaan nahay 'hal jir'. Markaan murugaysanahay, ma nihin kuwo keligood ah. Waxaan ku jirnaa wadaagga Masiixu. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa 'Diyaafadda Jannada', isagoo qoslaya. Sida uu ku yidhi riyadii aad aragtay, 'Ba, ma aha wax dhib ah, waan ku daawanayaa.' Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad sii waddo nolosha, inaad sii waddo riyada, inaad sii waddo inaad dhoolacaddayso.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in labadan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in; wuxuu ku jiraa xiriirka quduuska ah ee salaadda. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay.

Ceelka biyaha ee 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' ee Cà Mau waa calaamad muujinaysa in naxariistii Ben ay weli u qulqulayso sidii biyo nadiif ah oo kale, iyadoo quudinaysa dadka oomman. Magaciisa 'Đại Dương' oo macnaheedu yahay Badweyn Weyn wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in naxariista Ilaah ay ka ballaaran tahay murugo kasta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horey u joogtay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla joogto had iyo jeer.
standing_petitions: Wiilkayaga Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, inuu Rabbigu u naxariisto oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah oo iftiinkiisa ku jirta.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo, gaar ahaan qoyska Ben oo u baahan naxariistiisa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidaas daraaddeed, kuwa aan jeclahayow, sanam caabudidda ka carara. Waxaan u hadlayaa sidii dad garasho leh; idinkuba garsoora waxaan leeyahay. Koobka barakada ee aynu barakayno, miyaanu ahayn wadaagga dhiigga Masiixu? Kibista aynu jajabino, miyaanay ahayn wadaagga jidhka Masiixu? Waayo, kibistu waa mid, innaguna in badan oo aynu nahay, waxaan nahay jidh qudha, waayo, dhammaanteen waxaan ka qayb galnaa kibista qudha. Bal eega reer binu Israa'iil xagga jidhka; kuwa allabariga cuna, miyaanay ka qayb galin allabariga? Haddaba maxaan leeyahay? In hilibka sanamyada loo allabaryo uu wax yahay? Mise sanamku inuu wax yahay? Maya, waxaan leeyahay waxa ay allabaryaan, waxay u allabaryaan jinniyo, ee uma allabaryaan Ilaah, mana doonayo inaad jinniyo la wadaagtaan. Ma cabbi kartaan koobka Rabbiga iyo koobka jinniyada toona. Ma ka qayb gali kartaan miiska Rabbiga iyo miiska jinniyada toona. Mise Rabbiga ayaan ka masayrsiinaynaa? Miyaan isaga ka xoog badannahay?

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Sidee baan Rabbiga ugu celin karaa wanaagga uu ii sameeyey oo dhan? Waxaan qaadan doonaa koobka badbaadada, oo waxaan ku baaqi doonaa magaca Rabbiga. Adiga, Rabbiyow, ayaan u bixin doonaa allabariga ammaanta, oo waxaan ku baaqi doonaa magaca Rabbiga. Waxaan Rabbiga u bixin doonaa nidarradayda hortooda dadkiisa oo dhan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yidhi: 'Geed wanaagsan midho xun ma dhaliyo, geed xunna midho wanaagsan ma dhaliyo. Geed kastaba waxaa lagu gartaa midhihiisa. Waayo, dadku berde kama gurtaan qodax, canabna kama guraan geed qodax leh. Qofka wanaagsan wuxuu qalbigiisa ka soo saaraa wanaag, qofka sharka lehna wuxuu qalbigiisa ka soo saaraa shar; waayo, afku wuxuu ku hadlaa waxa qalbiga ka buuxa. Maxaad iigu yeedhtaan, 'Rabbiyow, Rabbiyow,' laakiin aanad samayn waxaan idinku amrayo? Qofkii i ag yimaada, oo ereyadayda maqla, oo sameeya, waxaan tusi doonaa waxa uu la mid yahay. Wuxuu la mid yahay nin guri dhisaya, oo si qoto dheer u qoday, oo aasaaskii dhigay dhagax; markii fatahaaddu timid, webiguna guriga ku dhacay, ma ruxi karin, waayo, si wanaagsan baa loo dhisay. Laakiin kii maqla oo aan samayn, wuxuu la mid yahay nin guri dhulka dul dhigay iyada oo aanu aasaas lahayn. Markii webigii ku dhacay, gurigii isla markiiba wuu dumay, wuxuuna noqday burbur weyn.'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-Third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: can't stop thinking about you Ben... wishing i could go back into time and try to change things around... maybe spend more time with you and less working so much. Please pray for me and mom.
